# Historical Exa Primary-Source Snapshot: GOOGL

Snapshot date: 2026-07-04 run artifacts. This is regression evidence, not a current investment claim.

## Material Change And Why It Matters

Alphabet's first-quarter release reported consolidated revenue growth of 22%, Google Cloud revenue growth of 63%, and operating-margin expansion to 36.1%. The investor relevance is not the headline growth alone: Cloud acceleration and margin expansion provide a primary-source check against the social claim that AI infrastructure demand was converting into operating results.

## Source Quality And Verification

These are direct company exhibits discovered and extracted through Exa, so they outrank commentary or social summaries for the reported figures. A final report should still reconcile the period, units, and later filings before treating the snapshot as current.

- [Alphabet Q1 2026 results exhibit](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000043/googexhibit991q12026.htm)
- [Alphabet June 2026 investor presentation](https://blog.google/alphabet/investor-presentation-june-2026/)

## Reader Decision

Use the primary documents to verify growth and margin claims, then compare them with capex, cash-flow, and backlog conversion before changing confidence.
